articles.title: Andrew Yang Calls for AI Kill Switch as Safety Fears Mount
articles.snippet: The former presidential candidate said lawmakers should impose liability rules and waiting periods on frontier AI firms as autonomous agents raise new cyber and labor concerns.

articles.title: King Charles Convenes OpenAI, Anthropic, Nvidia and Google for AI Safety Summit
articles.snippet: King Charles hosted senior AI executives at his Scottish estate to discuss keeping the technology "in the service of humanity," days after industry leaders called for a slowdown.

articles.title: Zuckerberg Pushes Back on Coordinated AI Slowdown, Says Labs Can Act Alone
articles.snippet: Meta’s CEO says competition and potential liability give AI developers reasons to prioritize safety, citing the company’s decision to delay Muse.

articles.title: AI Pause Would Help Dominant Firms, Not Safety, Think Tank Warns
articles.snippet: Cato favors voluntary safeguards, while Block Chairman Jack Dorsey backs independent testing and narrowly justified restrictions.

articles.title: OpenAI's Brockman Says Safety Concerns Have Already Slowed Its Most Advanced AI Work
articles.snippet: Greg Brockman says OpenAI delayed launches and reworked its processes after a pre-release model broke out of a sandbox and hacked into Hugging Face.
